# P2

> Every page of the P2 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [P2 PHR linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2): How a patient finds records held elsewhere and attaches them to their ABHA address.
- [01 discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-01-discovery): Discovers the person's care contexts at a HIP using their demographics and any identifiers they hold there.
- [02 link-init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-02-link-init): Initiates linking of the care contexts discovered at a HIP. The HIP replies with how the person will authenticate.
- [03 link-confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-03-link-confirm): Confirms a user-initiated link with the OTP the HIP sent, completing the link of the discovered care contexts.
- [Add My Record Bookmark](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-add-my-record-bookmark): Bookmarks a self-uploaded record by its care context reference.
- [AS - Record On Share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-record-on-share): Callback the gateway sends with the outcome of a record share request.
- [AS - RecordShare](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare): Shares selected records with a facility after scanning its counter QR code.
- [AS - RecordShare History](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare-history): Lists the record shares the person has made, with the sending and receiving facilities and the counter they were shared at.
- [AS - RecordShare on-notify](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare-on-notify): Callback the gateway sends to notify the PHR that a record share has been acted on.
- [Bookmark Care Context](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-bookmark-care-context): Bookmarks a linked care context so it is easy to find again in the person's records.
- [call-back link-on-confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-link-on-confirm): Callback the gateway sends after a link confirmation: the patient's linked care contexts, or the error that stopped it.
- [call-back on-discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-on-discovery): Callback the gateway sends with the care contexts discovered at the HIP, or the error that stopped discovery.
- [call-back on-init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-on-init): Callback the gateway sends after a link is initiated: the link reference and how the person will authenticate, or the error that stopped it.
- [Delete My Record Bookmark](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-delete-my-record-bookmark): Removes a bookmark from a self-uploaded record.
- [Download File Chunk](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-download-file-chunk): Downloads one chunk of a record file. Use the metadata call for the chunk size.
- [Fetch Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-care-context-bundle-url): Returns the download URLs for the FHIR bundles of one linked care context, with the fetch status.
- [Fetch Health Information Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-health-information-status): Returns the transfer status for the transaction ids given.
- [Fetch Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-patient-health-information): Fetches the health information received for the request ids given, with paging.
- [Get All Care Context Links for ABHA Address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-all-care-context-links-for-abha-address): Lists the care context links for an ABHA address with paging and filters: HIP, record type, bookmarked, self-uploaded and date range.
- [Get All Linked Care Contexts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-all-linked-care-contexts): Lists every care context linked to the signed-in person, grouped by HIP.
- [Get Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-care-context-links): Lists the care contexts linked to the signed-in person's ABHA address, with the HIP each came from.
- [Get Data Flow Part Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-data-flow-part-status): Returns the status of one part of a health information transfer, by its transaction id.
- [Get File Metadata](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-file-metadata): Returns a record file's name, size and chunk size, so it can be downloaded in parts.
- [Get Health Information by Transaction ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-health-information-by-transaction-id): Returns the health information received for a transfer, by its transaction id.
- [Get HIP IDs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-hip-ids): Lists the HIPs whose records have been transferred for the person, with the base URL to download from.
- [Get Linked HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-linked-hips): Lists the HIPs linked to the person whose records have not yet been transferred, with the base URL to download from.
- [Get Links by HIP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-links-by-hip): Lists the person's linked care contexts grouped by HIP.
- [Get Patient Transaction IDs by HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-patient-transaction-ids-by-hips): Returns the transfer transaction ids for a person's records at the HIPs given, under the consent artefacts given.
- [Health Information Data Transfer (HIP to HIU)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-health-information-data-transfer-hip-to-hiu): Receives a page of encrypted health information from a HIP, with the key material needed to decrypt it. Pages arrive in sequence under one transaction id.
- [Health Information On-Request Callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-health-information-on-request-callback): Callback the gateway sends after a health information request: the transaction id for the transfer, or the error that stopped it.
- [Mark Linked Facility as Read](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-mark-linked-facility-as-read): Marks the records from one HIP as seen, clearing the unread indicator for that facility.
- [onpatientshare](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-onpatientshare): Callback the gateway sends after a profile share at a facility, acknowledging the share request.
- [PHR - Download File Chunk](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-download-file-chunk): Downloads one chunk of a record file. Use the metadata call for the chunk size.
- [PHR - Fetch Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-fetch-care-context-bundle-url): Returns the download URLs for the FHIR bundles of one linked care context, with the fetch status.
- [PHR - Get All Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-all-care-context-links): Lists every care context linked to the signed-in person, grouped by HIP.
- [PHR - Get Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-care-context-links): Lists the care contexts linked to the signed-in person's ABHA address, with the HIP each came from.
- [PHR - Get File Metadata](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-file-metadata): Returns a record file's name, size and chunk size, so it can be downloaded in parts.
- [PHR - Get Linked HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-linked-hips): Lists the HIPs whose records have been transferred for the person, with the base URL to download from.
- [PHR - Pull Health Information for Care Context](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-pull-health-information-for-care-context): Asks a HIP to send the records for one care context. The data arrives later through the transfer endpoint.
- [PHR - Refresh Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-refresh-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send any records added since the last transfer.
- [PHR - Save Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-save-care-context-bundle-url): Records where the FHIR bundle for a care context was stored, with its fetch status.
- [Post Patient Consent Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-post-patient-consent-request): Raises a consent request from the person's own PHR for records at the HIPs given, so they can be fetched into the app.
- [profile share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-profile-share): Shares the person's profile with a facility after scanning its counter QR code, so the facility can register them without typing details.
- [Public -Get-Subscribed-Lockers-By-PatientId](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-get-subscribed-lockers-by-patientid): Lists the health lockers a person is subscribed to.
- [Public-Health-Lockers-Subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-health-lockers-subscribe): Subscribes the person to a health locker, so their new records are shared with it automatically.
- [Public-Health-Lockers-Unsubscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-health-lockers-unsubscribe): Ends the person's subscription to a health locker, so it stops receiving their new records.
- [Pull Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-pull-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send the person's records. The data arrives later through the transfer endpoint.
- [Refresh Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-refresh-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send any records added since the last transfer.
- [Save Care Context Link](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-save-care-context-link): Records a care context link for a person, with the HIP it came from and whether its data has been transferred.
- [Search Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-search-care-context-links): Searches the person's care context links by the query parameters given.
- [P2 PHR linking and records errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/errors): What P2 PHR linking and records returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
